content:
Feedback after Light’s adjustment
**1.    Add Easy instead of lower Hard:**
There were 5 tiers from A1 to A5. This update compresses them into 2 tiers, Normal and Hard. That much compress would make the difficulty feel steep no matter what, lower Hard difficulty just result in making go from Hard to Nightmare more steep and instead of get people who usually clear A3,A4 in awkward situation, this put people can clear A5 in that situation, people still enjoy the challenge, it just need to be a reasonable one. And it also not resolve the problem that newbie still can’t clear normal while they can clear A1 before. Just add an Easy tier equal to A1, normal ~A3, and Hard like right now is okish except for W5. This would make the difficulty progression feel much smoother instead of having such a sudden jump. It would also make clearing Hard feel more meaningful, since it would be the 3rd difficulty, not the bottom half.
**2.    Increase the points from extra clears from 5 to 10**
This way, 10 normal = 5 hard, 10 hard = 5 nightmare ... just like it used to be. This would still be a challenge, so it wouldn't take away the reward for players who work hard to clear the higher difficulties. Instead, it gives players more ways to earn the higher-tier rewards without necessarily having to deal with the extreme HP inflation. It would also make team building more diverse and give more Awakeners a chance to shine, which fits Morimen's motto: no one gets forgotten. Now if you look at the leader board, the team use to deal with HP inflation are all the same; it either %HP or cheese strat, it make the game unfun when you can’t play your favorite team. And there are many player invest horizontally too so play all extra to earn point of the higher tier used to be the way but now it force them to invest in just few meta team.

**3.    About the Perfect clear**
This is just QoL concern but can the dev add something like Hard Clear, Nightmare Clear…. Before by clear A5 you got Perfect Clear, it give you some sense of achievement; and now when you clear Hard with the same effort it just grey, even Nightmare feel like a failure and discourage, it’s like you try harder but it look like you not good as before. 

Those are my main feedback, about the HP adjustment of Nightmare we’ll need to see how it go, and funny that Madness is not touch while even whale has to use cheese strat to beat it but it not my most concern rn. Hope dev can see this.
